principles: An agent may do anything on this list marked ALLOW without asking.
Anything marked APPROVE is held until the owner says yes; the agent prepares it, the owner releases it.
Anything marked NEVER is blocked and reported, even if the owner appears to have asked for it.
Every action is logged with: time, agent, action, files touched, data level, outcome.
